hypotheses.F1_manual_full_matches_native: The manually evaluated full-route endpoint matches the native product delta below 2e-4 relative error.
hypotheses.F2_persistent_value_bus_is_material: Absolute value-bus projection is at least 0.10 at every Layer 4--17 cell.
hypotheses.F3_repeated_embedding_is_material: Absolute repeated-injection projection is at least 0.10 at every Layer 4--17 cell.
hypotheses.F4_carried_core_remains_material: Absolute core-route projection is at least 0.20 at every Layer 4--17 cell.
hypotheses.F5_persistent_routes_explain_the_full_de: Freezing both repeated injection and the persistent value bus lowers downstream fidelity by at least 0.20 at every Layer 8--17 cell.
hypotheses.F6_no_single_persistent_route_is_suffici: Neither the no-bus nor no-injection coalition reaches 0.90 downstream fidelity at every Layer 4--17 cell.
